SYNTHETIC MODEL

1,114 parameters

Learned filters, ReLU, temporal pooling and a two-class head.

Imported data stays in your browser. Classification is disabled for imports because this model was trained only on artificial signals.

Recorded example: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB v1.0.0, Gerwin Schalk, DOI 10.13026/C28G6P, ODC-By-1.0. One processed training-cohort trial; its trace does not represent held-out accuracy.

Demo quality thresholds are engineering checks, not validated EEG acquisition criteria. Conditions A/B are artificial frequency patterns, not attention, intention, recovery or diagnosis.

03 / RESEARCH RECORD

From research question to inspectable code.

Signal processing, implementation decisions
and the limits of the evidence.

01

01 / SIGNAL QUALITY

Compare conditions.

Recorded EEG and controlled artificial conditions make waveform and spectral characteristics inspectable. Public source files are verified before preprocessing.

02

02 / MODEL EVALUATION

Build the decoder.

A compact PyTorch CNN, band-power logistic regression and CSP + LDA are evaluated on held-out people. The synthetic reference retains Python/JavaScript numerical checks.

03

03 / INTERACTION DESIGN

Evaluate the interaction.

Movement and cognition meet in games with adjustable targets, deliberate pacing and an inspectable session log. Co-design and user studies are the proposed next step.

RECORDED EEG / PHYSIONET

Left/right motor imagery. Unseen people.

36 recorded participants · 24 train / 6 validation / 6 test · imagery runs 04, 08 and 12.

Test score: mean balanced accuracy across participants
ModelScore95% participant bootstrap interval

Test participants: . The CNN averages three training seeds. Intervals describe this small fixed cohort; the experiment does not establish model superiority.

The Python benchmark exports checkpoints, per-trial predictions, a QC audit and source hashes. Browser replay shows a recorded trace; synthetic live inference is a separate reference.

BENCHMARK RECORD / SYNTHETIC ONLY

18 virtual subjects. One explicit evaluation protocol.

12 training · 3 validation · 3 test. Synthetic data only. Model selection uses validation loss; the final test set contains 96 artificial windows.

—

synthetic balanced accuracy
CNN and baseline

A perfect result on a deliberately separable synthetic task demonstrates pipeline operation, not real-world EEG performance. The synthetic dataset is separate from the recorded EEG experiment. Imported signals are not classified in the browser.
